discussion_comments.comment_body: `catch` only resets on thrown errors, but this function has normal return paths that keep the Electron process alive: `applyUpdatesPosixInApp()` returns manual/failure/manual-restart results without throwing. Those paths will permanently leave `updateInFlight` true. Retain the lock only after a confirmed detached handoff; reset it for every non-handoff return.

This sleep/retry loop only helps locks that release on their own. Current main already disables matching gateway Scheduled Tasks before deletion (`scripts/install.ps1:1643-1663`), so please re-scope the stated Scheduled Task respawn rationale or add a mechanism that handles a continuing external watchdog.
